Strength: Bulletproof armor and modular combat payload options; fiber-optic control option is immune to RF jamming
Limitation: Wheeled platform's cross-country mobility is more limited than tracked combat UGVs
Estimated quantity available: Fielded numbers not publicly disclosed
employment_notes: Provides direct fire support from a remote position, letting infantry suppress enemy positions without exposing personnel - a concrete example of casualty-reduction through robotics
contrast_vs_traditional: Traditional infantry assault doctrine puts soldiers first through the most dangerous seconds of a breach or a fortified approach. A remotely operated fire-support ground robot exists to put a machine into exactly that moment instead of a person — a direct answer to the doctrine.md finding that FPV and mine density have made close assault the highest-casualty phase of an engagement.
